message: Thanks, John, and thanks for the source. I'll have to check it out (though probably not anytime soon, what with The Serch and all). By the way, re your recent [response](http://machinamemorialis.blogspot.com/2005/11/image-culture-by-christine-rosen.html) to Christine Rosen -- her work (including, also, the ["Egocasting"](/weblog/archives/2005/05/13/on-egocasting/) piece) seems to me to mesh well with that of Thomas de Zengotita, and the arguments that both of them make seem to owe a considerable debt to Ong's thinking.
